0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Grizzlies host the Utah Jazz. Utah is missing Blake Hinson (hamstring), Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps), and Trey Alexander (knee), all listed as out, while Memphis's Isaiah Stewart (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the most recent meeting came on April 10 in Salt Lake City, where Memphis lost 147-101.
